name: Number with unit
summary: A fixed-width digit input with the unit written inline as its short label (a seconds unit is always "sec"), a hover ▲/▼ stepper, a hard digit cap, clamp-on-change, and an error line — the settings field for a number that carries a unit.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-number-with-unit> — for a number that carries a UNIT: a duration, points, a per-item count (SETTINGS-45). The unit is written INSIDE the field as its conventional SHORT label — a seconds unit is always `sec`, never `s` or `seconds` (SETTINGS-46) — so it never reads as a selectable box beside the input. A hover-revealed ▲/▼ tertiary stepper nudges the value; a hard digit cap (`maxdigits`, default 4 — a 5th keystroke is ignored) and clamp-to-min/max on change AND blur keep it valid without deliberate misuse; an `errormessage` prop draws a red border/ring and a message line below. The host is the accessible spinbutton (role="spinbutton", aria-valuenow/min/max, ArrowUp/Down + PageUp/Down). Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; motion on persistent nodes. Zero drift — the same element in React and Vue.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: height 32 (default) · radius 8 · digit input + inline unit + stepper

spec.label: Unit
spec.value: 12/18–14/21 #8A8A8A inline suffix; conventional short label (sec, not s/seconds)

spec.label: Stepper
spec.value: ▲/▼ tertiary (system-caret-up/down), revealed on hover/focus; disabled at min/max

spec.label: Digit cap
spec.value: maxDigits (default 4) — a keystroke past the cap is dropped; numeric only

spec.label: Clamp
spec.value: value clamps to min/max on change AND blur (immediate fallback)

spec.label: Error
spec.value: #F5222D border + ring + a 12/18 #F5222D message line below; sets aria-invalid

props.name: unit
props.desc: Inline suffix — the conventional SHORT label (sec, pt, %) — never s/seconds

props.name: maxdigits
props.desc: Hard digit cap — a keystroke past this many digits is ignored

props.name: size
props.desc: Control height — small 24 · default 32 · large 40; radius stays 8

props.name: errormessage
props.desc: Presence draws the red border/ring and the message line below

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on commit / stepper / arrow; read e.detail.value (clamped number)

whenToUse.when: a number the host does NOT provide that carries a unit — a per-item timer, points-per-answer, a spin duration
a standard whole-slide countdown — use the host-native enableTimeLimit, not this
the unit itself is changeable — a unit dropdown, not an inline suffix

opinion.note: A fixed unit is an inline suffix inside the field (SETTINGS-41) — a bordered box beside the input implies the unit is selectable. Always the short label: `sec`, never `s` or `seconds` (SETTINGS-46). Ship pre-filled with the recommended default and clamp immediately.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab NumberWithUnit control mapped into the DS. Box, border and focus ring reuse the DS V3 field family; the inline unit, hover stepper, digit cap, clamp-on-change/blur and errorMessage line are the settings-specific additions (SETTINGS-45/46/41/25).
